title: The Offensive Slows
subtitle: German operational difficulties and Soviet resistance around Moscow, Tula, and Crimea.
author: R.G. Cruise
summary: German operations falter near Moscow and Tula while fighting continues around Tikhvin and in Crimea.
outlineTopics: The German military situation entering November.
The consequences of the October encirclement battles.
Army Group Center's reduced operational strength.
The effects of damaged roads and autumn mud.
German attacks against the city's approaches beginning in late October.
The role of Soviet 50th Army and local defensive formations.
Soviet defensive operations along the central front.
German preparations for further offensive operations.
Army Group North's continuing campaign toward Tikhvin.
The contrast between German strategic ambitions and the practical condition of the army.
researchStatus: Research brief. Full study and dated military reconstruction in preparation.
